findings.issue: Qal sequential perfect 3fs (be unclean) is only a bare adjective; the finite predication is implicit.
Preposition min is narrowed to desde (point of origin), which can be read as temporal rather than partitive of/from.
כי אם is compressed into sino; the conditional if is only implicit in the subjunctive.
